text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder finishes the race with<n>splendid
results.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But it seems Maruzensky's absence<n>is still
weighing on her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky feels ignored, admitting<n>frustration at how
dismissive Grass<n>Wonder is of the rivals right in
front of<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Only then does Grass Wonder realize<n>she hasn't
truly clashed with her<n>contemporaries.
